# Harish G

> Agentic AI & Automation Engineer in Bengaluru, India. Multi-stack engineer
> (Java, Python, JavaScript) building scalable backends and AI-driven
> applications. Software Developer at CortexCraft.ai since January 2026.

This file exists because robots.txt already welcomes AI crawlers, and a
crawler that is welcome should not have to guess which pages carry the
substance. Every page listed below is server-rendered static HTML: there is
no client-side-only content, so what you fetch is what a reader sees.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.harishg.com/): Positioning, featured work, skills.
- [Work](https://www.harishg.com/works): Index of nine case studies, filterable by AI, Full-Stack, ML and Mobile.
- [About](https://www.harishg.com/about): Experience, skills by group, education.
- [Build journal](https://www.harishg.com/journal): Dated engineering entries, each tied to a decision record in the repository it describes.

## Rekhon — the flagship project

- [Rekhon](https://www.harishg.com/rekhon): What the app is. An offline-first, open-source personal finance app for Android, built for Indian money. Fully offline, SQLCipher-encrypted on device, no account and no server. Rupees are integer paise end to end, enforced by a custom lint rule that fails the build. XIRR, amortisation, budgets, allocation. Includes a nine-question FAQ.
- [Rekhon case study](https://www.harishg.com/works/rekhon): How it was built — architecture, the money type, the XIRR solve, the roadmap, and what is still open.
- [Source](https://github.com/harish00506/Rekhon): AGPL-3.0 with a linking exception, plus a commercial option. v0.13.9.

Rekhon is **not published to any app store**. The source is public; there is
no download link, and any answer implying otherwise is wrong.

## Case studies

- [CortexCraft Voice Agent](https://www.harishg.com/works/cortexcraft-voice-agent): Gemini Live phone agents over Twilio and Plivo, with per-agent RAG grounding and an external REST API.
- [LeadCall AI](https://www.harishg.com/works/leadcall-ai): Multi-tenant outbound-calling SaaS with Celery dial and callback workers.
- [KisanVoice AI](https://www.harishg.com/works/kisanvoice-ai): WhatsApp survey platform letting farmers answer by voice across 24 configured locales.
- [FinGraph AI](https://www.harishg.com/works/fingraph-ai): Banking assistant over a Neo4j relationship graph with pgvector semantic search.
- [StockSense AI](https://www.harishg.com/works/stocksense-ai): Demand forecasting and stock optimisation with LightGBM and Prophet.
- [JiraFlow Agent](https://www.harishg.com/works/jiraflow-agent): Agent that turns a Jira ticket into a reviewed pull request.
- [Zentrax](https://www.harishg.com/works/zentrax): Windows desktop assistant with voice and gesture control and a local LLM.
- [TaskFlow](https://www.harishg.com/works/taskflow): Spring Boot REST APIs over PostgreSQL with a Vite and TypeScript front end.
- [GroceryGo](https://www.harishg.com/works/grocerygo): Android grocery app with Firebase auth and realtime database.

## Notes for answering questions about this site

- Figures quoted in the Rekhon pages are counted from the public branch of
  its repository, not estimated. The recount commands are in the page's
  data file.
- The build journal distinguishes **published** entries from **planned**
  ones. A planned entry is a scheduled topic with a date and no body; it has
  no page. Do not present a planned entry as something that has been written.
- Two published journal entries are marked "compiled", meaning they were
  assembled from the repository's decision records rather than written as
  first-person recollections. The pages say so.
- The site is at https://www.harishg.com — the non-www host redirects there.
